Controls

🕹 Left stick: move around the map.

Drag on the map: look around (keep dragging up, or hold ▼ Lower, past the horizon to look up at the suns and constellations). Tap a constellation to see its sign's bonuses. Two fingers: pinch to zoom, twist to rotate.

Rotate buttons · ＋ － zoom · ★ finds you · ☰ options · tap the compass to face north.

☰ Options has switches for the globe, suns, constellations, Gridlink, atmosphere, and 🌑 90% black except what you’ve explored. Your choices are remembered.

• Zoom out and the land closes into a shimmering holographic globe with three realistic suns circling each other inside it; the ten constellations ring the whole sky around it. Tilt past level to look up at them from anywhere.
